cohort: 12 women (age range, 23-42 years; mean, 34.1 years) who underwent caesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
finding: The use of NBCA instead of GS in prophylactic pelvic arterial embolisation for PAS during caesarean hysterectomy was associated with reduced procedure time for hysterectomy and total blood loss.
mod_finding: The study compared different embolic materials for prophylactic pelvic arterial embolization during cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum.
